title: Bend the words
description: Live sketch text follows an editable curve. Change the wording or reshape the baseline; the letters follow.
tryThis: Double-click the lettering, select the text, then edit its words or drag a curve handle.

title: Make a circular badge
description: Readable lettering along the bottom of a circle. Its construction guide shapes the words without becoming a solid disk.
tryThis: Double-click the lettering and drag the circle’s points, or move the text with its position slider.

title: Keep your stencil together
description: A real OPEN stencil with bridges connecting the enclosed letter centers to the plate.
tryThis: Double-click the stencil, select OPEN, and change the bridge width or the wording.

title: Print the whole word
description: Raised letters share a thin, connected backer. The lettering stays editable and the result is one fused part.
tryThis: Double-click MAX to edit it. In 3D properties, change the backer thickness or raised-letter height.

title: Build between shapes
description: A square base flows through a hexagon into an SVG heart. Each section has its own shape, size, and height.
tryThis: Select the loft and expand Section layers. Change the middle polygon’s sides or drag a section into a new order.
